templates.template: #!/bin/sh <%text> sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.forwarding=1 sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.forwarding=1 sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=1 sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.default.forwarding=1 for dir in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*; do echo 1 > "$dir/forwarding" echo 0 > "$dir/send_redirects" echo 0 > "$dir/rp_filter" done for dir in /proc/sys/net/ipv6/conf/*; do echo 1 > "$dir/forwarding" done </%text> # BEGIN SCE UPLINK ALLOWLIST <%text> set -eu command -v iptables >/dev/null command -v ip6tables >/dev/null ip link show dev eth1 >/dev/null iptables -w -N SCE_UPLINK_OUT 2>/dev/null || iptables -w -S SCE_UPLINK_OUT >/dev/null iptables -w -N SCE_UPLINK_IN 2>/dev/null || iptables -w -S SCE_UPLINK_IN >/dev/null iptables -w -t nat -N SCE_UPLINK_NAT 2>/dev/null || iptables -w -t nat -S SCE_UPLINK_NAT >/dev/null iptables -w -t nat -N SCE_UPLINK_DNAT 2>/dev/null || iptables -w -t nat -S SCE_UPLINK_DNAT >/dev/null iptables -w -I FORWARD 1 -i eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP iptables -w -I FORWARD 1 -o eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP ip6tables -w -I FORWARD 1 -i eth1 -j DROP ip6tables -w -I FORWARD 1 -o eth1 -j DROP iptables -w -F SCE_UPLINK_OUT iptables -w -F SCE_UPLINK_IN iptables -w -t nat -F SCE_UPLINK_NAT iptables -w -t nat -F SCE_UPLINK_DNAT iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_OUT -i eth1 -j DROP ip route replace 129.108.4.46/32 via 11.0.0.254 dev eth1 ip route replace 129.108.156.63/32 via 11.0.0.254 dev eth1 iptables -w -t nat -A SCE_UPLINK_DNAT ! -i eth1 -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 100.100.100.100/32 -p tcp --dport 8080 -j DNAT --to-destination 129.108.156.63:11435 iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_OUT -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 129.108.156.63/32 -p tcp --dport 11435 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED --ctdir ORIGINAL --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.100 --ctorigdstport 8080 -j ACCEPT iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_IN -s 129.108.156.63/32 -d 13.0.0.101/32 -p tcp --sport 11435 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED --ctdir REPLY --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.100 --ctorigdstport 8080 -j ACCEPT iptables -w -t nat -A SCE_UPLINK_NAT -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 129.108.156.63/32 -p tcp --dport 11435 -m conntrack --ctdir ORIGINAL --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.100 --ctorigdstport 8080 -j SNAT --to-source 11.0.0.68 iptables -w -t nat -A SCE_UPLINK_DNAT ! -i eth1 -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 100.100.100.101/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -j DNAT --to-destination 129.108.4.46:443 iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_OUT -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 129.108.4.46/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED --ctdir ORIGINAL --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.101 --ctorigdstport 443 -j ACCEPT iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_IN -s 129.108.4.46/32 -d 13.0.0.101/32 -p tcp --sport 443 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED --ctdir REPLY --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.101 --ctorigdstport 443 -j ACCEPT iptables -w -t nat -A SCE_UPLINK_NAT -s 13.0.0.101/32 -d 129.108.4.46/32 -p tcp --dport 443 -m conntrack --ctdir ORIGINAL --ctorigsrc 13.0.0.101 --ctorigdst 100.100.100.101 --ctorigdstport 443 -j SNAT --to-source 11.0.0.68 iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_OUT -j DROP iptables -w -A SCE_UPLINK_IN -j DROP while iptables -w -C FORWARD -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_OUT 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -D FORWARD -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_OUT; done while iptables -w -C FORWARD -i eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_IN 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -D FORWARD -i eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_IN; done iptables -w -I FORWARD 1 -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_OUT iptables -w -I FORWARD 1 -i eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_IN while iptables -w -t nat -C POSTROUTING -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_NAT 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -t nat -D POSTROUTING -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_NAT; done iptables -w -t nat -I POSTROUTING 1 -o eth1 -j SCE_UPLINK_NAT while iptables -w -t nat -C PREROUTING -j SCE_UPLINK_DNAT 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -t nat -D PREROUTING -j SCE_UPLINK_DNAT; done iptables -w -t nat -I PREROUTING 1 -j SCE_UPLINK_DNAT while iptables -w -C FORWARD -o eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -D FORWARD -o eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP; done while iptables -w -C FORWARD -i eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP 2>/dev/null; do iptables -w -D FORWARD -i eth1 -m comment --comment sce-uplink-update -j DROP; done </%text> # END SCE UPLINK ALLOWLIST
